items.title: preservedFlags did not carry durability wear, so every transfer (a copy made, the original deleted) handed a worn tool over as new
items.old_state: fixed in 1.2.43 (AUDIT-1.2.42.md 2.2: 'preservedFlags zachowuje wear'; commit 90c17021 of 12.09.2026, the first tag that holds it is v1.2.44 - this clone has no v1.2.43 tag)
items.evidence: scripts/inventory.mjs:167-171: preservedFlags reads wearOf(item) and writes ITEM_FLAGS.wear on the copy. Since E35 every change of owner is one function, transferItem (inventory.mjs:1136), whose copy is made with extraFlags: preservedFlags(held) (:1267) and taken back when the piece no longer carries what the copy carries (carriedAs, :1194, :1312-1315). Its five callers are the five roads the finding named: handover.mjs:558 (loot) and :1001 (give), palm.mjs:698 (steal) and :877 (plant), stash-reach.mjs:550 (a stash rifled).
items.pinned_by: tier 2 'a hand-over on transferItem keeps what the GMs hold of the item - broken, wear, roles, identity, kind, category and tier - ... (E35-T2, give)' (tests-tier2.mjs:77158), with its siblings for a body's loot (:77212) and for a steal, a rifle and a Plant (:77830); each fixture is a tier 3 Tool made with wear 2
items.refutation_tried: Listed every caller of grantItem (10 sites) and of transferItem (5) in scripts/ outside the tests, looking for a copy road that skips preservedFlags: none - the other grantItem callers make new things (a Search's find, a GM's give, a key, a Truth Bullet, an improvised weapon, a Reroll's find), not copies of an owned item.
items.note: The same function also carries a key's room since 22.09 (inventory.mjs:173-178).

The approval window names the killer from the proposal first (projects-ui.mjs:1264 killerIdFor(result.viewers?.[0], start?.by), killerIdFor at :1576-1584 answers the proposer when there is one) and passes both by and killerId to createProject (:1306-1328).

items.title: The Gear rule 'one in a hand, at most one stowed' (LIMIT_GROUPS.gear.maxStowed) was asked in one place, putting a readied item down; every way a Gear arrives only counted the two slots, so two stowed Gear could be carried for good
items.old_state: task 5 left it as a question; decision D4 of 13.09.2026 (AUDIT-1.2.42.md 9.1): option A, auto-ready on every way in, with a whisper to the owner (commit 12109493)
items.evidence: The code does what D4 chose. grantItem ends on keepGearShape for a carried arrival (inventory.mjs:918), which readies the arrival, or the working piece stowed beside a broken one, and whispers DRPG.Items.autoReadied to the owner (:963-1007, :999); retrieve asks the same on the way out of a stash (stash-reach.mjs:175-185, :203-204). Every owner change goes through grantItem (transferItem, inventory.mjs:1259). One amendment by the owner: an unseen Plant leaves the planted piece stowed and readies the victim's other piece without a word (E91 C8, D090, 12.11.2026; inventory.mjs:952-985).
items.pinned_by: tier 2 'an improvised weapon goes into the killer's hand once: beside one stowed Gear the shape readies it ... (E14-T7, S08-36)' (tests-tier2.mjs:79967); 'retrieving a broken Gear beside one stowed never leaves two stowed (S08-36)' (:76986); the unseen Plant's two tests (:78050, :78122)
items.refutation_tried: Looked for a way in that skips keepGearShape: its callers are grantItem and retrieve only (git grep), and the one hook on an item's creation that the module's limits own, preCreateItem (inventory.mjs:1323-1343), counts the slots and nothing else.
items.note: Not established, and left as a question: an Item document that already carries the module's category flag and is created on a sheet by Foundry's own drop (a sidebar or compendium item) or by a GM's console passes preCreateItem's count and never reaches keepGearShape, so two stowed Gear could stand until the next arrival. Whether such a document exists outside sheets in a real world was not read.

items.title: stow did not clear the readied flag, and retrieve wrote only the place back, so an item came out of the stash still readied: two readied items, and the one check of ITEM-04 stepped past
items.old_state: fixed in 1.2.43 (AUDIT-1.2.42.md 2.2: 'stow() zdejmuje equipped'; commit 90c17021)
items.evidence: scripts/stash-reach.mjs:117-124: stow's one write sets location, the stash's room and flags.<module>.equipped false. retrieve then runs the Gear shape rule (stash-reach.mjs:203-204), and readying anything puts every other readied carried item down (use-items.mjs toggleEquipped, the loop over readiedItems).
items.pinned_by: none found that stows a readied item and reads the flag afterwards; tier 2's S08-12 test feeds the same three-key write to the GMs' audit as the legal stash write (tests-tier2.mjs:76892-76894)
items.refutation_tried: Looked for another road into a stash that keeps the flag: grantItem's overflow makes a new item with no readied flag (inventory.mjs:878-896), and a transfer's copy does not carry it (preservedFlags, :141-181).
items.note: Not traced to its end: a player's console write of the place alone (location and stashRoom, no equipped) is judged by sheet-audit.mjs placeStands (:2275-2295), which does not ask the readied flag, so by that road an item could still lie in a stash readied. An honest sheet cannot make that write.

items.title: A trap's plant is keyed by room and outlived its project: after the project was deleted in the manager or the season reset, the next Search in the room still found the planted item; the trap ledger grew an orphan row a plant
items.old_state: task 5 of AUDIT-1.2.42.md section 5 (commit e38d22a6, 12.09.2026, 'Items: the rules are enforced where they were being broken'; shipped in 1.2.44)
items.evidence: Both roads the finding named prune now. The manager's delete button calls deleteProject (projects-ui.mjs:498), one change { remove: true } (projects.mjs:2669-2673) carried out on the primary GM (projects.mjs:1698), whose step queues pruneTrapsFor(the ids that still have a row) (projects.mjs:1930), run right after it (projects.mjs:1600-1606); the season reset's clearAllProjects calls pruneTrapsFor(null) inside its step (projects.mjs:2717-2718). pruneTrapsFor drops every plant and ledger row of a project not kept (traps.mjs:597-615). Both stores are synced GM stores since E04, so the cut reaches every GM.
items.pinned_by: none found that deletes a project and reads its plant gone (git grep of trapPlantStore, trapLedgerStore and pruneTrapsFor in the suite and the scenarios)
items.refutation_tried: Looked for a way a project goes without pruneTrapsFor: the module's own delete and reset both prune; Daggerheart's own edit button is taken off the tray for a GM (projects-ui.mjs:122).
items.note: takePlant itself still asks nothing of the project (traps.mjs:544-566): scenario 40-flow plants under a project id that is no project and its Search is handed the plant (40-flow.mjs:150). So a plant whose countdown was removed outside the module (Daggerheart's own Countdowns window, opened some other way) or planted from a console for no project would still be found; that road was not traced.

new_observations.title: The overflow whisper names the item's category where the limit that was hit is the shared Gear's
new_observations.what: A find that does not fit goes to the stash with DRPG.Vault.overflowed, 'You cannot carry any more {category} ...', and {category} is ITEM_CATEGORIES[category].plural, not capacityLabel(category). A student carrying two Tools who finds a Murder Weapon is told they cannot carry any more Murder Weapons while they carry none. The refusals beside it (inventory.mjs:819, :851) use capacityLabel. The Polish line also adds 'on this scene' (the stash 'na tej scenie'), which the English does not say.
